BENIGN: Scoop Extras e6a1621669bf and GithubActions 3.0.0 5bceeda.

and Extras parent 2a6fc1256e from upstream Git repositories; archives in scratch.
Extras adds only bucket/kirocrew.json, a conventional pinned installer manifest.
Its profile helper and excavator workflow are unchanged from the parent.
ModifyPSProfile.psm1 adds/removes Import-Module lines for installed modules.
Scoop.psm1 replaces download-to-file and & $f -RunAsAdmin with IRM | IEX at the
SAME official ScoopInstaller/Install/master/install.ps1 URL, adding installed
shim reuse and conditional updates. Github.psm1 adds pagination and job-log/rate
limit helpers, Bearer auth and removes token-bearing request logging. The action
switches from an obsolete Node bootstrap to a composite pwsh action. Reviewed
execution, API authentication and event dispatch diffs: innocent version drift;
no substituted payload destination or added secret export.

Changes: match-level official installer exclusion retains other command evidence;
response-eval composite requires pipeline syntax instead of neighboring names;
remove redundant profile-write objective, retain notable filesystem behavior and
consumer exclusions; remove redundant request-near-IEX objective, retaining the
neutral atoms directly in its embedded-command consumer. Ancestor consumers are
PHP/JS-specific or already select neutral eval atoms. No new directories.

Facts inspected for both archives and all named modules. Final atomscan using
this worktree with --no-update --mode slow --follow=none: Extras archive, action
archive, Scoop.psm1 and Github.psm1 have zero hostile and suspicious findings.
Archive verification includes the profile helper. All five controls pass:
official command, mixed official/untrusted, lookalike URL, unrelated request/eval
and ordinary profile setup. Mixed and lookalike retain hostile/suspicious traits.
